_comment: Self-maintained MCX CRUDEOIL reference. VERIFY every value against the current MCX contract spec / circulars and refresh yearly + on each roll.

session._comment: MCX evening close shifts with US daylight saving: ~23:30 IST during US DST, ~23:55 IST otherwise.

contracts._comment: Fill from Dhan instrument master. security_id here overrides DHAN_CRUDEOIL_SECURITY_ID when today <= expiry.

holidays._comment: Add full + partial MCX holidays from the yearly MCX circular, e.g. {"date": "2026-10-02", "type": "full", "name": "..."}
